landing_dek: Two lines kept side by side. Devotional items are produced for the Indian trade, wholesale and white-label. The Pattachitra is hand-painted in Odisha and prepared for buyers in the United States. Both catalogues are open — browse them, and get in touch about anything in either.
landing_description: Devotional items for the Indian wholesale trade, and hand-painted Odisha Pattachitra for buyers in the United States.

sections.door_blurb: Regional deities and temple motifs produced as tabletop objects on FDM machines. Supplied wholesale and white-label to the Indian trade, in metal-filled, stone and matte finishes.
Odisha's temple painting tradition on hand-built cloth pata, in natural pigment, sourced direct from painter families in Raghurajpur and exported to the United States.
